title: Out-of-scope getters for one source repo (config/<source>/out-of-scope-getters.json). The walker treats their targets as labelled leaves; every other getter is in scope.

getters.description: Getter to the reason it is out of scope. A key is a getter signature, e.g. owner(), out of scope on every contract; or <ContractName>.<signature>, e.g. L1WethGateway.l2Weth(), out of scope only on contracts whose code or implementation matches an entry with a contract of that name (the part after ':' in its fully qualified name). Code the registry doesn't know only sees the first kind.
